entities.name: Albanian Mosque, Dandenong

entities.summary: The Albanian Mosque, also known as the Albanian Islamic Centre Mosque and Albanian Sakie Islamic Centre, is a mosque located in Dandenong, a south eastern suburb of Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. It is one of the earliest mosques in the country.
